title: The first message
quote: Heyy, this is Kwaku Biney. Just checking if this is Esther? So i can save the number
note: I knew it was you. I just needed a reason to talk to the most beautiful girl i had ever seen. So i asked a question i already had the answer to.

title: A burger at Junkies
quote: Ohhhhhhh, i remember when everyone had eaten about 3/4 of their burger and you had taken one bite 😭
note: We went to Junkies with some friends. Everyone else was basically done and she had barely started. Her relationship with food is peculiar, she said. We got burgers together a couple more times after that and suddenly she ate fast. So what was happening that first day?

title: Introduction to Junkies
quote: Ohhhhhhh, i remember when everyone had eaten about 3/4 of their burger and you had taken one bite 😭
note: I still get bacon cheese burger extra spicy just because of her till this day.

quote:
wanted you to know you’re on my mind a lot, and it acc calms during the day and i have sth to look forward to.

Always thinking about you, don’t forget that.

It’s fine, thinking about you makes it easier, I find solace in that.

I wake up thinking about you on most days.
note: So many different ways of saying the same thing. I thought about her constantly and i was not very subtle about it.

title: Why can’t I just see you tomorrow
quote: Ugh so why can’t I just see you tomorrow or something
note: I wish i could see you every single day. That was always the dream.

title: Spend the day with you
quote: I would prefer to spend the day with you
note: I miss being w you and laughing at random tiktoks

title: I miss you
quote:
Sep 12 — last thing on my mind before i sleep and the first thing when I wake up
Sep 24 — I miss you too much
Oct 17 — the past three Fridays i’ve spent them with you, and I miss you
Oct 20 — I want to FaceTime you tonight, I miss your face
note: We said it so many times it almost lost meaning. Except it never really did.

title: Why do I love you
quote: I love the way you get excited about silly viral dances. I love it when the little child in you comes out. I love the way you get lost staring at the ceiling randomly. I love that you wear the necklace I got you. I love it when i get you food and I can tell you’re absolutely hungry. I love a lot of things about you. And this is how I know it’s not superficial.
note: I wrote this at 1 AM because i physically could not sleep without her knowing. She woke up, said it was the sweetest thing. I meant every word.

title: Thanks for taking me to Toronto with you
quote: My eyes are closing, I tried, hope you enjoy your final night!! Thanks for taking me to Toronto with you!! Next time we’re travelling together. You’ve been amazing these past few weeks, and i’ve grown more in love with you each day. Thanks for the stuff u got me! Thanks for thinking about me. Thanks for being the best woman ever. I love being your man, and i would do anything to make your life easier and more enjoyable. I love you. Goodnight!
note: She went to Canada in October 2024 and i was in Ghana. We FaceTimed across time zones, did the whole long-distance thing. The night before she flew back from Toronto Pearson, i sent this at 2:29 AM. She said she definitely grew more in love with me over those weeks.

title: Asian Noodle Garden
note: Second date I think. Noodles tasted like it was dipped in light soup but it was such a great time and she looked so beautiful.

title: Play Accra

note: It felt like us being parents. I just felt like I was your husband and you were my wife and it just felt perfect.

title: You’d definitely get lost
